tools.name: search_trade_tools
tools.description: Find AI and software tools for small trades businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, lawn care, cleaning, pest control, contractors). Filter by trade, task, category, and max monthly price. Data from tradeswithai.com, checked against each vendor site.

tools.name: get_trade_tool
tools.description: Get full details for one tool in the tradeswithai.com directory: description, quoted prices with source text, integrations, trades served, and check date.

tools.name: compare_trade_tools
tools.description: Compare 2 to 12 trades tools side by side on price, category, trades, and integrations. Pass tool slugs, or a comparison slug like "ai-receptionist-pricing".

tools.name: search_saas_vendors
tools.description: Search 300+ SaaS vendors tracked by SaaS Price Watch by name or category (crm, email, dev, design, ai, payments, and more). Returns the smallest monthly figure on each pricing page and the page URL.

tools.name: get_vendor_pricing
tools.description: Get the public plan prices for one SaaS vendor, each with the quote from its pricing page and the date checked.

tools.name: recent_price_changes
tools.description: List SaaS price changes detected between weekly checks: prices added and removed, with dates and source links.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_saas_vendors · Public sink: search_saas_vendors.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_saas_vendors · Public sink: search_saas_vendors

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
